verdict.rationale: Blaxel has an official CLI documented at a dedicated CLI reference, integrable into CI via a GitHub Action, and used for API key auth alongside SDK/API — consistent with AI-native, agentic workflows (deploying agents, sandboxes, MCP servers, jobs).
